WHAT IS CONSTRUCTED (not assumed, not faked):
1) S1896IdentityOpenImmersion : for EVERY field F and etale stack Y, Iut.EtaleStackOpenImmersion (id Y.fiber). This is the FIRST inhabitant in the tree of EtaleStackRepresentableMorphismProperty. Proof is a construction, per test scheme T and scheme point p: S1896IdentityBaseChange Y T p : EtaleStackBaseChangePresentation (id Y.fiber) T p with pullbackScheme=T, projection=id T, toSource=p, and a FULL TwoPullbackWitness S1896IdentityPullback (apex = the test scheme; it is the actual 2-pullback of the cospan (id,p) = S1804's "apex = the scheme" model, so no schematic fiber product beyond T is needed). All 7 witness fields proved: lift=cone.toY, liftToX from the cone's 2-commuting square + right unitor, liftToY from the unit comparison of the 2-Yoneda 1-cell S1896YonedaOneIso (S1742StrongTransOfHom (id T) ~ id h_T, proved from Category.comp_id), liftTwoCell=m.toY; the two 2-cell laws use the right-whiskering unit law and the fact that 2-cells into a REPRESENTED stack are subsingleton (S1896Modification_subsingleton). hasProperty = IsOpenImmersion (id T.left).

2) Exact first missing, localised: S1896CuspEquivOpenData : OrbicurveBoundaryCusp X ~ Sigma D : S1896CuspOpenData X, S1896CuspPointData D, and S1896FirstMissing_structure (l) (S) : Nonempty (S1887D9CuspFirstMissing l S) <-> exists D : S1896CuspOpenData S.cK, Nonempty (S1896CuspPointData D). So the D9 cusp = (compactification stack Z, representable open immersion S.cK.stack -> Z, boundary point outside the image).

3) Anti-fake (non-substitution): S1896Id_not_boundary = the identity open map can NEVER satisfy the boundary condition (for any candidate compactification = X.stack and any candidate point); S1896Cusp_openMap_app_not_essSurj = every cusp's open map fails to be essentially surjective at its own boundary residue scheme; S1896D9Cusp_identity_not_openImmersion = D9 specialisation. Hence the constructed identity open immersion is explicitly NOT offered as the cusp: the identity case proves the representability machinery is NOT the obstruction, and the remaining input is the geometric compactification of C_K (downstream of the still-missing S1881D9OrbicurveMissing). No compactification, no cusp, no non-identity open immersion is constructed; mathlib scheme pullbacks are not used.

ENGINEERING NOTE (reusable, cost several cycles): on Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans X Y two defeq-but-not-syntactically-equal Category instances coexist (EtaleStackPseudofunctor.homCategory global in Iut/Foundations/Orbicurve.lean, and mathlib's scoped Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.homCategory). Consequently Bicategory.whisker_exchange / whiskerRight_id / whiskerRight_iff / whiskerLeftIso / rightUnitor do NOT elaborate directly at EtaleStackPseudofunctor F (hom-type metavars stay unsolved). Fix: the S1756 pattern, generalised in S1896 section 0 - let Bicat := EtaleStackPseudofunctor F; letI : Bicategory Bicat := inferInstance; exact @Bicategory.<lemma> Bicat _ ... . Also: after simp only [Category.assoc] a mixed-instance 2-cell goal can remain and rfl closes it. Future open-immersion / finite-etale representability work should reuse S1896WhiskerLeftIso, S1896WhiskerRightIso, S1896LeftUnitorIso, S1896RightUnitorIso, S1896WhiskerRightId, S1896WhiskerExchange, S1896WhiskerRightIff, S1896Modification_subsingleton.
